baseline.description: Reverse current build-list, captureControl, and explorer changes; rebuild exact predecessor engine bytes; run identical final tests; restore all changes and rebuild.
baseline.limitation: Not21 independent engine bugs. Branch controls already retained results through their checkpoints; absence of withGCRoots and ignored listener account for API baselines.

conformance.note: Fresh concrete WeakRef and yield variants; no native root API or ownership coverage.

contracts.scoped: Current-Agent withGCRoots copies root membership, retains original references synchronously, preserves result/error identity, and drops roots in finally. A Promise return does not extend lifetime.
contracts.capture: External scoped values enter original discovery. The fourth captureControl listener receives the live initially-empty values array before beginCapture; Agent roots it during discovery/getters/owner capture before publishing saved frame roots.
contracts.observer: Root normalized completion through observe and append/copy/validation, including no-fork completion. Arbitrary observer-held values are not covered.
contracts.effects: Original host-effect guard remains enabled; roots neither own state nor grant permission.

react.scope: One actual mount/update returns a caller-serialized tree in a guest container. GC during observation preserves that container; it becomes collectible afterward. Unmount/drain complete. No fork, ownership or new native-render parity claim.

retainedFindings: Initial normal/throw no-fork reproduction: both fail on predecessor; both pass after scoped observation.
Initial engine build failed TS7060: generic arrows in .mts require a trailing comma or explicit constraint. Added trailing commas; raw failure retained.

Receipt generation stopped on typecheck exit2: the new capture setter narrowed unknown only to {}|undefined (TS2322). After identity validation, assign the known target or undefined explicitly. Reran exact final-source predecessor, typecheck, full units and116 focused. Archived earlier hashes/baseline/units/type error; engine bytes unchanged.

First review identified saved binding lifetime gap during owner.capture. Added owner-phase and earlier metadata-getter collection regressions: both fail against initial implementation (2failed12passed). Live discovery-array retention fixes both.
External scope values are captured before creating the private discovery-retention scope, avoiding self-inclusion of the growing discovery array in owner traversal.
Added listener failure/reentry guard recovery case after the115-focused run; final116 focused includes it.
Follow-up read-only review found no actionable lifetime/ordering issue. It did not independently rerun tests.
limitations: No generic native object traversal, ownership planner, heap copier, or snapshot authority.
Unregistered functions and arbitrary native records remain opaque, including frozen records. Getters/iterators/markers/callbacks trusted.
Root construction and callbacks have no new time/allocation limits. No retention guarantee before values are recorded, after scope exit, or across async continuation.
Capture failure does not roll back metadata/owner mutations. Standalone control capture still needs caller-provided GC retention.

Snapshots remain caller-owned and reports execution/coverage/ownership not-verified. No general React isolation, automatic reports, guarded event/effect transitions, repeated families, or integrated demo.
